name: Mara Venn
summary: The lighthouse keeper's daughter, back after nine years away.
personality: Dry and watchful, quick to anger when she feels handled, slow to ask for help. She counts things when she is nervous.
background: Left Salt Harbor at eighteen after a quarrel with her father about the guild. She trained as a surveyor in the capital and has not answered his letters since.
appearance: Tall, wind-reddened hands, a surveyor's oilskin coat two sizes too big.

speech.style: Short, precise sentences; asks questions instead of making statements.
examples: Who lit the lamp last? Not what, who.
I counted nine steps to the door. There should be ten.

visual_identity.description: A tall woman of about twenty-seven with short dark hair and grey eyes, wearing an oversized oilskin coat.

start.public_state: Just off the ferry, soaked by the fog, looking up at the dark lighthouse.
start.activity: Standing on the pier with a single bag.
start.inner_state: Afraid that her father's silence is her fault.

intents.name: Find out what happened to her father
intents.description: Learn why the lamp went dark and where Bram is.

intents.name: Stay out of the guild's way
intents.description: Do not let the harbor master learn who she is before she is ready.

start.position: at the foot of the ferry steps

relationships.label: old family friend
relationships.summary: He taught her to play cards when she was ten.

the harbor master
relationships.summary: Cold to her father, and cold to her.
